meta.title: Clockwork/coloring correspondence
meta.definition: kappa(M,v) = N*tau mod N; H = ker(kappa); color group = G//H
meta.kernel_method: Classify the tau=0 spatial operations plus their own translation lattice against the 17 canonical wallpaper groups.

groups.clockwork_description: o is the direct-product forward group over wallpaper orbifold o (p1), classified in the Triclinic system with a P lattice. Every displayed spatial operation has phase 0.
groups.coloring_description: The phase character is trivial, so H = G and the associated traditional plane pattern is the one-colour group o//o. The static plate is monochrome.
groups.image_alt: Static 1-colour wallpaper plate induced by clockwork group o: asymmetric motifs carry phase colours for o//o.

groups.clockwork_description: 2₁2₁2₁2₁ is a non-product forward clockwork group over wallpaper orbifold 2222 (p2), classified in the T-Monoclinic system with a P lattice. Its phases form C2; the catalog cosets show 2-fold rotations: 1/2.
groups.coloring_description: The zero-phase kernel H is orbifold o (p1); it preserves every colour and is the frame-preserving wallpaper subgroup. The traditional perfect cyclic colouring is 2222//o, with [G:H] = 2 and G/H isomorphic to C2. An operation at phase j/2 sends colour k to k+j modulo 2.
groups.image_alt: Static 2-colour wallpaper plate induced by clockwork group 2₁2₁2₁2₁: asymmetric motifs carry phase colours for 2222//o.

groups.coloring_description: The zero-phase kernel H is orbifold 2*22 (cmm); it preserves every colour and is the frame-preserving wallpaper subgroup. The traditional perfect cyclic colouring is 4*2//2*22, with [G:H] = 2 and G/H isomorphic to C2. An operation at phase j/2 sends colour k to k+j modulo 2.
groups.image_alt: Static 2-colour wallpaper plate induced by clockwork group 4₂*2: asymmetric motifs carry phase colours for 4*2//2*22.
